environment.scope: Matched hardware before/after single edits and bursts
environment.renderer: Hardware ANGLE on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, OpenGL ES 3.2

method: Both builds start from identical copies of one saved filesystem/database snapshot, including generated media, settings and edit history. Five native ArrowUp then Enter Start commits per project after 4.5 seconds warm-up. Keydown to confirmed stage after decoded hold capture and paint. Eight-key bursts repeat three times per requested rate. Acceptance requires confirmed stage plus live timing equal to the final saved snapshot. Earlier unpaired runs are retained locally and are not used for this comparison.

fixtures.plain: 240 linked video/audio pairs and 20 titles, over a generated 60-second H.264/AAC file. scripts/timeline-performance.ts timelineWorkload(500).
fixtures.interview: 10 linked interview cuts, four b-roll pieces, music and four titles with an authored GSAP timeline, from the ownership-study recipe. Always reloads.

parity: Eight persistent-live-page versus fresh-document PNG pairs: six NTSC cut checkpoints, undo and redo. Linked source-in/rate, linked one-frame duration trim, title move, 30000/1001. An authored init-time GSAP case reloads and also matches a fresh page.
policy: Inspect source with the same HTML parser as the compiler, before runtime injection; include template contents and hoisted fallback markup. No authored scripts. Only exact pinned GSAP library bytes are exempt. Parent eligibility comes from a server record for its navigation, never iframe messages. Compare current live DOM before a patch; fail closed on divergence.

budget.definition: Median of five live commits < 80% of median of five direct-reload controls, alternating order on the same runner and identical document. Parent HTTP authorization is disabled for the control; it does not pay the live timing-snapshot request first.
budget.rationale: The old 600 ms ceiling failed in CI at 627/647 ms. A relative check guards a material saving across hardware speed differences.
budget.browserSettings: Playwright defaults, no explicit hardware-GL override

unit.skips: Four opt-in native Electron checks and installed local Whisper

validation.ports: App servers 4950/4951, Playwright 4959, existing restart server 4952; two unit fixture ports temporarily remapped to 4953/4954 and restored.
validation.memory: free -g checked before heavy runs; final standalone performance suite started with 13 GB available.
